in_marathi.name: Navinraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navinraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navin means 'new' and raj means 'ruler' in Sanskrit. This name is associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing the new and fresh beginning of a ruler.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Navinraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Navin means 'new' and raj means 'ruler' in Sanskrit. This name is associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing the new and fresh beginning of a ruler.
